meta.name: Flagged for Review — combined irregularity register
meta.note: Items here are published for manual review. Per the project brief, flagged / unverified / needs-review items do NOT block the PR merge or the GitHub Pages deployment. Every row links to an official source; a value that could not be confirmed is left blank rather than inferred.
meta.label: ESTIMATION — not a real verified released schedule

flags.title: 2028 and 2029 MLB schedules are not released
flags.detail: MLB StatsAPI returns 0 regular-season games for 2028 and 2029. All 2028/2029 MLB rows on this site are ESTIMATION — not a real verified released schedule. Dates, opponents and times are blank on verified tables.

flags.title: 2027 NFL schedule and 2027–29 Westwood One postseason schedules are not released
flags.detail: No official 2027 NFL schedule or 2027–2029 Westwood One postseason broadcast schedule exists as of 2026-11-02. These are left blank and labelled ESTIMATION — not a real verified released schedule.

flags.title: 2,015 MLB 2027 games carry TBD first-pitch times
flags.detail: MLB StatsAPI returns startTimeTBD=true for 2,015 of the 5,861 checked 2026/2027 game records; the placeholder time is often 07:33Z. Start times are left blank on verified tables; the parallel session's modelled start times appear only in the clearly labelled planning-estimate mode.

flags.title: 24 official 2026 NFL games have no published kickoff time
flags.detail: The NFL.com by-week feed contains 321 HOF/preseason/regular games; 24 have no kickoff time (mostly Week 18 TBA). Those rows show blank times and are flagged.

flags.title: Super Bowl LXII (2028) and LXIII (2029) dates not published
flags.detail: The hosts are official (Atlanta 2028, Las Vegas 2029) but the exact dates are not. Date fields are blank.

flags.title: Westwood One vs 49ers kickoff conflict, 2026-11-22 MIN at SF
flags.detail: The official Westwood One schedule lists 7:30 PM ET (4:30 PM PT) while 49ers.com lists 5:20 PM PST for the Mexico City game. Both windows are blocked and the conflict is published rather than silently resolved.

flags.title: Older official Stanford / Cal future-schedule releases conflict with newer ones
flags.detail: Cal 2028: 2020 release put Wyoming on Sept 2, 2024 release puts UCLA on Sept 2. Cal 2029: 2020 release put Minnesota on Sept 1, 2024 release puts Wisconsin on Sept 1. Stanford 2027 TCU game was canceled in 2026. Newer sources are used; older entries are left blank or flagged.

flags.title: CFP radio partner not stated on official broadcast schedule
flags.detail: CollegeFootballPlayoff.com publishes 2026-27 CFP dates and TV networks but no radio partner. Radio carriage of CFP games on a 94122 AM/FM station is therefore unverified; the dates are shown as official anchors only.

flags.title: Westwood One Station Finder does not publish frequencies
flags.detail: The official Station Finder lists San Francisco affiliates by call sign (KNBR-AM, KNBR-F2, KNBR-FM, KTCT-AM) but no frequencies. Frequencies on this site come from separate official team / station / ESPN pages and are attributed individually.

flags.title: Westwood One warns not every affiliate airs every broadcast
flags.detail: Official wording: 'Because of local blackouts and/or programming conflicts, not every affiliate can air every Westwood One Sports broadcast.' National W1 windows are high priority but station-level carriage in 94122 is not guaranteed.

flags.title: Dashboard copy says Feb 8–13 2027 gap is 'after the Super Bowl'
flags.detail: Super Bowl LXI is officially Feb 14 2027, so the Feb 8–13 2027 window is BEFORE the Super Bowl. The root dashboard wording is corrected on our combined analysis page; the original wording is retained here as a documented irregularity.

flags.title: Prior sites referenced in the brief return GitHub Pages 404
flags.detail: buffedlizard55-lab.github.io/VacationSchedule/site/, /ScheduleFreeTime/, /RADIOSF/ and /VacationSchedule/ all returned 404 during review. This project builds a new self-contained site instead of relying on those pages.

flags.title: 2026 Big Game date conflict between two official school pages
flags.detail: calbears.com listed the Big Game on Sat Nov 14 2026 at 12:30 PM while gostanford.com listed Stanford at California on Sat Nov 21 2026 TBA. Both dates were blocked by the parallel session. The 2026 Cal schedule page now shows Stanford on Nov 21; the older Nov 14 entry is retained as a flagged conflict.

flags.title: Westwood One 2026-12-27 JAX at DAL time not retrievable
flags.detail: The parallel session could not retrieve a kickoff time from the official W1 event page; the time was left blank and marked unverified.

flags.title: 2026 Stanford Nov 14 kickoff listed as '4 OR 4:30 P.M.'
flags.detail: The official Stanford schedule page gives two possible kickoff times. Neither is inferred; both are listed as ambiguous and flagged.

flags.title: 2026 Stanford Nov 28 SMU kickoff TBA on schedule page
flags.detail: The official schedule card shows TBA while embedded JSON-LD carries a UTC timestamp; per the no-inference rule the PT kickoff is left blank and flagged.

flags.title: 2027 MLB All-Star Game and Opening Night times not published
flags.detail: MLB's 2027 release names dates (Mar 24, Jul 13) but not first-pitch times; those time fields are blank.

flags.title: Planning durations are estimates, not official values
flags.detail: 165/185/195/200-minute busy blocks are planning buffers around official rulebook playing times and MLB's official 2:38 average. They are labelled ESTIMATE and flagged; official rulebook facts are shown separately.

flags.title: Parallel verification report had failing row checks
flags.detail: An earlier verification/report.md recorded 49/62 rows verified, 13 failures and 3 conflicts; the published dashboard later reported 61/62. The combined verification page re-checks the merged data and lists any remaining failures instead of assuming they are resolved.

flags.title: Sacramento-market Athletics affiliates: 94122 reception unverified
flags.detail: KSTE 650 AM and KVMX 92.1/105.5 FM are official Athletics radio affiliates in Sacramento, but over-the-air reception in Outer Sunset 94122 is not confirmed by an official source. KNEW 960 AM is the Bay Area affiliate.
